login.subTitle: Per-key USD quota on existing Plus api-keys
login.memoryNote: The key stays in memory only and is cleared on refresh.
login.embeddedFallback: Could not reuse the panel management key. Enter it manually.
login.insecureBase: Warning: this is a plain http address, so the management key is sent unencrypted. Use https or a loopback address.

keys.empty: No bound keys. Unlisted keys are unlimited.
keys.syncConfirm: Import unbound Plus api-keys using their aliases as names, or previews when no alias is available. Existing preview names are updated when an alias is available; custom names and other policy settings are preserved. New keys start unlimited.
keys.syncDone: Synced: added {{added}}, already bound {{skipped}} (renamed {{renamed}}), Plus total {{total}}.
keys.syncAliasesUnavailable: Plus aliases were unavailable; keys were synced without aliases.
keys.unbindConfirm: Unbind {{id}}? Plus api-keys are not deleted.
keys.resetConfirm: Reset plugin 24H/7D usage for {{count}} keys? Limits stay the same. Plus usage is not cleared.
keys.resetOneConfirm: Reset plugin 24H/7D usage for “{{name}}”? Limits stay the same. Plus usage is not cleared.
keys.bulkDisableConfirm: Disable quota for {{count}} selected keys? Plus will still serve them.
keys.bulkUnbindConfirm: Unbind {{count}} selected keys? Plus api-keys are not deleted.
keys.invalidLimits: Limits must be non-negative numbers. Leave empty for unlimited.
keys.setLimitsHint: Leave a field empty to keep it unchanged; enter 0 for unlimited.
keys.nothingToUpdate: Enter at least one limit to change.

bind.title: Bind existing key
bind.name: Display name (optional)
bind.nameHint: No manual alias is required. Leave blank for the server to use the masked key preview as the name. Renaming does not change account bindings.
bind.keyHint: Used only to compute a hash. Disk and list keep sha256 + preview, never the secret.
bind.keyRotateHint: Leave blank to keep the current binding. A new value is hashed immediately and is not stored.

codex.title: Codex account binding
codex.hint: Bindings use stable AuthIDs; names are display-only. With no selected accounts and no group, Codex accounts are unrestricted. Multiple accounts use session affinity, with round-robin selection when no session is present.
codex.directoryAvailable: Host directory loaded. Recently observed accounts absent from the host directory remain unconfirmed and may be invalid.
codex.directoryUnavailable: The host directory is unavailable. Any listed accounts are only recent observations, not a complete directory. You can enter AuthIDs manually and save existing bindings.
codex.search: Search ID, email, label, name or status
codex.searchHint: Filtering does not remove selected accounts.
codex.noResults: No matching accounts. Clear the search or enter AuthIDs manually.
codex.label: Label
codex.name: Name
codex.missing: Absent from directory / invalid; binding retained
codex.manualHint: Separate AuthIDs with newlines, commas or semicolons (including Chinese punctuation). Leading and trailing whitespace, empty entries and duplicates are removed; spaces within IDs are preserved. Pending text is also merged on Save; directory failures never remove selected IDs.
codex.groupHint: Optional. Leave empty for no group restriction.
codex.fallback: Allow fallback to other Codex accounts
codex.fallbackHint: Off by default. Only when no usable Codex account matches the binding may selection widen to other Codex accounts.

schedulerDiagnostics.title: Codex binding scheduler diagnostics
schedulerDiagnostics.warning: Home mode bypasses plugin schedulers, so bindings do not take effect; ensure this plugin is the highest-priority scheduler.
schedulerDiagnostics.highestPriority: This plugin is the highest-priority scheduler
schedulerDiagnostics.unavailable: Diagnostics unavailable: no recent scheduler.pick call information was obtained. The call count is unknown, not a known zero.
schedulerDiagnostics.noCalls: No scheduler.pick calls have been received recently. Check Home mode and scheduler priority settings.
schedulerDiagnostics.observationHint: The host interface cannot currently detect these states. Counts and timestamps only show calls observed by this plugin, not that bindings are effective. Data does not refresh automatically.

usage.noModels: No per-model usage in this window yet.
